question: As of November 2026, who is the President and CEO of Walmart Inc.?
answer: As of November 2026, John Furner is President and CEO of Walmart Inc. [1][4] Walmart's November 12, 2026 announcement of its third quarter earnings call names him as president and chief executive officer, and he will host the November 19 call alongside CFO John David Rainey [4][7]. Furner succeeded Doug McMillon, who was CEO from February 2014 to January 2026 [6].
